Export simulated datasets to parquet files

Source: R/api.R
sim_export.Rd

Generates synthetic data for one or all registered datasets and writes each file as a parquet file in a CBS VM-style folder layout: output_dir/UPPERCASECBSNAME/CbsName{YYYY}V1.parquet.

Usage

sim_export(
  output_dir,
  dataset = NULL,
  year = 2023L,
  n = NULL,
  seed = 42L,
  col_select = NULL,
  force_resim = FALSE
)

Arguments

output_dir

Directory to write parquet files into.

dataset

Dataset identifier, or NULL (default) to export all registered datasets.

year

Simulation year (default 2023).

n

Number of persons in the spine. NULL (default) uses the population count from bundled parameters.

seed

RNG seed for reproducibility (default 42).

col_select

Optional named list of character vectors specifying which columns to include per CBS file. Keys are CBS file names (e.g. "SPOLISBUS") or file keys (e.g. "spolisbus"). Identity/join key columns (defined in each manifest's key_columns) are always included. Files not listed are skipped entirely. Default NULL exports all files with all columns.

force_resim

Logical; if TRUE, regenerate all files regardless of what was previously simulated. Default FALSE skips files whose columns, n, and seed already match the .sim_meta.yaml in output_dir.

Value

Invisibly, a list with elements dir (the output directory), written (number of parquet files written) and skipped (number of files skipped because they were already simulated).
